name: yourconscience
description: Self-hosted marketplace for the dotagents cross-agent skill library: the whole repo as one plugin, plus portable skills as single-skill plugins.

plugins.name: dotagents
plugins.description: Cross-agent skill library and subagent roles from the dotagents repo.

plugins.name: tech-search
plugins.description: Search Hacker News, X.com, Reddit, Discord, and high-signal tech blogs for curated opinions on a topic.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Pressure-test a plan one question at a time until scope, dependencies, and open questions are concrete.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Final-pass rewriting for concise writing that keeps the user's voice and removes generic AI tone.

plugins.name: repo-eval
plugins.description: Find, triage, and deep-evaluate GitHub repos for a given need before adopting one.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Produce a minimal SPEC.md through a short interview and use it as the source of truth for complex work.

plugins.name: pr-triage
plugins.description: Inspect PR failed checks and unresolved review comments, fix valid feedback, and drive a single fix-commit-push loop.

plugins.name: tmux
plugins.description: Generic tmux reference for sessions, windows, panes, screen capture, and input.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Multi-persona code review with structured findings for diffs, PRs, and branches.
